context: A teacher and student discuss a diplomatic-history paper
purpose: Teach: 親善/発祥/庁舎/受動/刑罰/緊迫/牽引/症例

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、親善大使の歴史、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: Your paper on the history of goodwill ambassadors was really thorough.
lines.style: Warm, steady tone. Slight lean-in. Genuine interest without intensity. The ease of someone reading careful work and meaning it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。発祥は19世紀末、と位置づけました。
lines.en: Yes. I traced the origins back to the late nineteenth century.
lines.style: Careful, slightly formal. A small breath before the date—anchoring the claim. Quiet pride in the precision. No rush.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 庁舎での儀礼、丁寧に描かれていますね。
lines.en: The way you described the ceremonial protocols in government offices was really precise.
lines.style: Encouraging nod in the voice. Open, observant. Not rhetorical—genuinely noting what landed. Slight upward tilt at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 当時、受動的な外交が主流でした。
lines.en: At that time, passive diplomacy was the main approach.
lines.style: Measured explanation. Each phrase distinct but connected. The careful student building context for the listener. Small pause before 'passive'.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 刑罰の国際比較、緊迫した時代背景、伝わります。
lines.en: And the international comparisons of legal systems—you really captured how tense that historical moment was.
lines.style: Recognizing something that clicked. Warm but analytical. Slight emphasis on 'tense'—acknowledging the weight of the work. Steady eye-level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 文明発展を牽引する役割、近代国家が担いました。
lines.en: Modern nation-states took on the role of driving civilizational progress.
lines.style: Broader perspective now. Speaking from understanding, not recitation. A touch slower. Small exhale of settling into the larger idea.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 比較症例として、医学史と並べる試み、面白いですね。
lines.en: Pairing medical history as comparative case studies—that was a really interesting choice.
lines.style: Genuine delight. A small smile underneath. Recognition of something unexpected working. Warm and approachable. Trailing upward slightly.
